description: This Java class 'GatewayService' implements the main service for the Eclipse Ditto Gateway, responsible for initializing and starting the service using Akka actor system, configuring it with specific gateway configurations, and defining main entry point logic.

classes.name: GatewayService
classes.description: Main class providing the entry point for the Eclipse Ditto Gateway service, extending DittoService with Gateway-specific configuration and actor setup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point method that instantiates the GatewayService and runs it until termination.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificConfig
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to return gateway-specific configuration data.

methods.name: startDevOpsCommandsActor
methods.description: Method stub for starting DevOps commands actor; actual actor start is delegated to GatewayRootActor.

methods.name: getMainRootActorProps
methods.description: Provides configuration for the main Akka root actor specific to the gateway service.
